mapper.select: select StaffID, UserID, RealName, Gender, IDCard, BirthDate, DeptID, Phone, Email, EntryDate, StaffStatus from Base_Staff where UserID = #{userId} limit 1
select StaffID, UserID, RealName, Gender, IDCard, BirthDate, DeptID, Phone, Email, EntryDate, StaffStatus from Base_Staff where StaffID = #{staffId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into Base_Staff (StaffID, UserID, RealName, Gender, IDCard, BirthDate, DeptID, Phone, Email, EntryDate, StaffStatus) values (#{staffId}, #{userId}, #{realName}, #{gender}, #{idCard}, #{birthDate}, #{deptId}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{entryDate}, #{staffStatus})
